# mistershell_configure_resource_vars (Data Source)

Reads a MisterShell configure_resource_vars by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_configure_resource_vars" "example" {
  id = "123:456"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID. Specify either ID or an exact name; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.

### Read-Only

- `resource_id` (Number) Resource id.
- `stack_id` (Number) Stack id.
- `values` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Values.
